services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: This 90 minute excursion begins with a boat tour, exploring the waterways looking for dolphin & wildlife, we then stop at a sandbar only accessible by boat where you can explore & look for shells. Our 30 passenger fun boat is equipped with a restroom, padded seats & full shade for your comfort. Our Dolphin & Sandbar Tour provides a unique opportunity to see dolphins and get your feet wet on a secluded sandbar! It’s the ultimate surf & turf! Food & drinks welcome! (yep, even alcohol!) services.desc: Need someone to host your private event on Anna Maria Island? What more fun is there than to have a private party on a boat? MV Minnow has got you covered! In addition to our regular morning and afternoon cruises, you can celebrate your next event with MV Minnow’s Private Charter, the perfect venue for birthday parties, weddings, anniversaries, corporate events, and reunions. Our boat accommodates up to 20 people, so bring your friends and come aboard the M/ Minnow, guided by the knowledgeable and friendly Captain Frank Jones! services.name: Cruise Details
services.desc: Have you ever looked into the sunset and marveled at its beauty? If not, then our Anna Maria Island Sunset Cruises are perfect for you! Chances are, if you’re a vacationing tourist from another part of the U.S., then you haven’t had the opportunity to experience the unmatched beauty of an Anna Maria Island sunset! With its warm year-round temperature, tranquil aqua waters and white sandy beaches, Anna Maria Island surely is paradise. To add to this, it’s no surprise that our sunset cruises on the Gulf are among the most magnificent sights you will ever experience. A perfect ending to a beautiful day on Anna Maria Island, relax as you are engulfed by the breathtaking hues of the sky. Watch

blurb: Guests can enjoy dolphin tours, sandbar excursions, sunset cruises, private fishing charters, and jet ski rentals on the waters around Anna Maria Island. The tours offer wildlife viewing including dolphins, manatees, and birds, with options for family-friendly and private experiences. The boat is a 30 passenger pontoon with shade, padded seats, and a restroom.
